siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of schanz. restaurant.
siblings.summary: Strict 30 km from Schanz: almost nothing. Trier (34 km by road, just over the limit) is the only real hub — and in late July it hosts the CiE/MCU/CCA/GSW cluster, the biggest theoretical-CS week in the region all year.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Weinhaus Piesporter Goldtröpfchen
sources.claim: Weinhaus Piesporter Goldtröpfchen is the Hain family's wood-panelled wine hotel in Piesport village.

sources.title: Visit Mosel — Weingut Koch
sources.claim: Weingut Koch is a traditional Mosel winemaker's house in the Dhron quarter of Neumagen-Dhron, ~5 km from Piesport.

sources.title: Visit Mosel — Wein- und Tafelhaus
sources.claim: Wein- und Tafelhaus in Trittenheim is an informal boutique hotel with seven rooms; chef Alexander Oos holds a Michelin star.

sources.claim: Wein- und Tafelhaus is listed in the Michelin Guide for Trittenheim.

sources.title: Moselhaus by Clüsserath-Wittmann
sources.claim: Moselhaus is a 2023 build with three vintner-owned apartments in Trittenheim, €140–210/night.

sources.title: Weinromantikhotel Richtershof — about
sources.claim: Weinromantikhotel Richtershof occupies a 300-year-old winery with a 16th-century cellar.

sources.title: Romantik Hotels — Richtershof
sources.claim: Richtershof is a four-star superior Romantik Hotel with 2 singles, 36 doubles and 5 suites.

sources.title: Doctor Weinstube — official
sources.claim: Doctor Weinstube occupies a 1668 tithe house in Bernkastel-Kues's old town; modernised in 2013.

sources.title: Bernkastel tourism — Doctor Weinstube
sources.claim: Doctor Weinstube has 25 doubles and 3 singles.

sources.title: Schloss Lieser — official
sources.claim: Schloss Lieser is a fully restored late-19th-century castle on the Mosel riverbank in Lieser.

sources.title: Marriott — Schloss Lieser, Autograph Collection
sources.claim: Schloss Lieser is part of Marriott's Autograph Collection.
